title: Postcode lifecycle, boundary and positional-quality guards

findings.finding: Postcode addresses can straddle administrative boundaries; centroid allocation can assign some addresses to another area.
findings.product_effect: No parcel broadband inference from postcode LAD alone.

findings.finding: Postcodes change continuously and can be reused in a different place after two years.
findings.product_effect: Epoch must match before geography binding.

findings.finding: ONSPD uses postcode grid reference point-in-polygon; NSPL uses OA then best-fit higher geographies.
findings.product_effect: Do not force equality between ONSPD and NSPL geography codes.
Low-quality or terminated coordinate states fail closed for exact parcel binding.

findings.finding: July 2026 contract data is initial-scope only, can omit deferred scope, is lagged and rounded.
Spring 2026 fixed/FWA availability, satellite affordability and commercial leased-line contexts are distinct.
